title: Tavern lean: release the pawn's object interaction (DPC 0.9.176-dev3)
intro: tavern-lean-5: the lean is an 'interacting with an object' action (the wall is an object the pawn uses). Walking, idle and ending the decision didn't free him. This run tries the game's own interaction cancels, one per step. Any of them might freeze the game: SAVE FIRST. Tavern; the test puts you on the Arisen. Press End.

steps.text: 1/7 Get ready: saved, in a tavern, playing the Arisen. Press End.

2/7 Stand still near a wall until one of your pawns leans on it (any pawn). It can take a minute or two; the pawn row on screen shows what each pawn is doing. End once one is leaning (don't take control yet).
3/7 Take control of the leaning pawn while it leans (the AI interrupt is off, so it will be stuck). Try to move. End.
4/7 Try 1: DPC now asks the game to cancel his interaction the way it does for townsfolk. Try to move. Note whether he's free. If the game freezes, close it, restart and tell Claude which try. End.
5/7 Try 2: DPC now asks the game to cancel his interaction with the wall. Try to move. Note whether he's free. If the game freezes, close it, restart and tell Claude which try. End.
6/7 Try 3: DPC now asks the game to end his interaction with the wall. Try to move. Note whether he's free. If the game freezes, close it, restart and tell Claude which try. End.
7/7 Back to the Arisen. Tell Claude which try freed him, if any. End.
